children.value: > Fact From Story: OpenAI said it has pushed out its co-founder and CEO Sam Altman after a review found he was “not consistently candid in his communications” with the board of directors.
> > Fact From Story: “The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI,” the artificial intelligence company said in a statement.
> > > Fact From Story: OpenAI declined to answer questions on what Altman’s alleged lack of candor was about.
> > > Fact From Story: The statement said his behavior was hindering the board’s ability to exercise its responsibilities.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A board of directors' responsibility is to oversee the company's operations and ensure it is acting in the best interests of its shareholders.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If a board of directors does not have confidence in a CEO, they are likely to fire them.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Being pushed out of a company means you have been fired.
